mechanism: Clarithromycin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism and increase hydrochlorothiazide levels; both drugs can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia) and clarithromycin has QT-prolongation potential in context of thiazide-induced hypokalemia.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) and QTc interval; consider potassium supplementation or alternative antibiotic if prolonged clarithromycin use is necessary.
